## Verification

Record commands run and actual results, including existing failures. Do not describe a candidate as accepted into `main` or PUBLIC RELEASE READY before the applicable review and checks.

- [ ] No personal state, conversations, private paths, credentials, copied source prose, game assets, leaks, or unauthorized extraction output.
- [ ] Publisher intent, observations, uncertainty, and review boundaries remain distinct.
- [ ] Generated files were rebuilt rather than edited by hand.
- [ ] Relevant tests and required checks pass, or blockers are explicitly reported.
- [ ] The diff stays within the adopted milestone and fixed data scope.

## Recovery

Identify the previous reviewed source revision or exact revert needed to restore the prior behavior.
